samples.xml_description:
<module id="parallel2serial">
    <description>Parallel to Serial Converter</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operations.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal. Defined as 0 for reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="d" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit parallel data input.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Valid signal indicating the availability of serial output.</output>
        <output id="dout">Serial output representing the converted data.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>
        Assign the most significant bit of the parallel input to the serial output (dout). On each clock cycle, if the counter (cnt) is 3, indicating the last bit of the parallel input, update the data register (data) with the parallel input (d), reset the counter (cnt) to 0, and set the valid signal (valid) to 1. Otherwise, increment the counter (cnt) by 1, set the valid signal (valid) to 0, and shift the data register (data) one bit to the left, with the most significant bit shifted to the least significant bit.
        
        Counter Register: If the reset signal (rst_n) is high, the register (cnt) is incremented by 1.
    </implementation>
    
</module>
